damage_assessments.note: assessment dates are not in the requested fields; points are post-event inspections
damage_assessments.privacy: address, parcel (APN), owner-value and structure-detail fields are not requested or stored

limitations: Ventura polygons are what the County's public map showed at each Wayback capture; their issue times are not on the map.
No LA County order polygons were found (no archived LA County / City of Malibu evacuation map); LA areas are TIGER cities named whole or null-geometry described areas.
Hill Fire zones are kept as map context (fire_name 'Hill') with no order events.
Zones overlap (for example Bell Canyon and Saddlebow); the crosswalk lists each zone separately.

fire_perimeters_shared_schema.note: Same FEDS F17192 features as normalized/fire_perimeters_feds.geojson, in the Kincade schema. That legacy file labels them 'reconstructed'; this one follows Kincade ('derived'). First snapshot 2018-11-09T08:00Z, about 9.6 h after the first report.

population.selection: bbox-intersecting block groups; sums exceed the evacuated population

limitations: OSM is community mapped and may omit roads or 2018 access restrictions.
Service roads were not requested; private/no-access ways are excluded.
Unknown directional lane counts and speeds remain null.
Exit nodes are geometric boundary crossings; only major-route exits get a derived destination label.
No turn restrictions or signal timings.
